projectDescription: A self-hosted web proxy powered by Ultraviolet and service workers that lets users bypass internet censorship and access blocked websites through a password-protected, themeable frontend.
keyFeatures: Ultraviolet-powered service-worker proxy for bypassing internet censorship
Password protection per domain stored in a JSON file with live-reload
Multiple themeable UI skins (16+ themes including Catppuccin flavors, vaporwave, mountains, etc.)
Wisp WebSocket transport for encrypted proxied traffic
EpoxyTransport (default) and CurlTransport support via bare-mux
"Open Blank" mode that disguises the proxy in a separate window
One-click deployment to Replit, Railway, Glitch, and Koyeb
REST API for programmatic link/password management
publicApiSurface: POST /api/addLink — add a domain+password entry (requires ADD_LINK_PASS auth)
GET /check?domain=<hostname> — check whether a domain is in the allow-list
WS /wisp/ — Wisp WebSocket endpoint for encrypted transport
GET /purple/* — Ultraviolet static assets (uv.bundle.js, uv.config.js, etc.)
ENV PORT — TCP port the server listens on (default 8080)
ENV ADD_LINK_PASS — shared secret for the addLink API
